svg.aria-label: Umbra Unit Frames — the modern set
svg.title: Umbra Unit Frames — the modern set
svg.text: The arrangement Dragonflight introduced. Player and target meet in the lower third, buffs above them, the pet under the cast bar and the debuffs under the pet. The party column goes to the
left edge, centred on it: it is about four other people and does not belong in that gathering.
UIParent 1365 x 768 — the default scale on a 16:9 screen
as many as MAX_BOSS_FRAMES, right edge, centred
